newsitem.title: GERMANY: TNT extends world freight service to 70 countries.
newsitem.headline: TNT extends world freight service to 70 countries.

text.p: TNT Express Worldwide said it has extended its door-to-door World Express Freight (WEF) service to more than 70 countries outside Europe.
The service targeted the heavy air cargo market by offering defined delivery times for shipments without weight or size restrictions, a TNT statement said.
"The transport of a shipment from Cologne to Bangkok is guaranteed within four days, for example," the statement said.
Customers could track and trace their shipment using the Web Tracker software on the TNT Internet home page, it added.

The WEF door-door complete rate covered pick-up, export documentation, express air transport, shipment monitoring, customs and distribution, the statement noted. --Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom. Tel +44 171 542 7706; Fax: 5017
